rules_guide.title: How regular matches work
rules_guide.subtitle: A quick guide to matchmaking, coins, wins, draws, and match history.
rules_guide.start_text_1: Choose a game on the Home screen, configure the available options, and start searching for an opponent. Coins are not deducted while you are searching. The entry fee is charged only when a match is actually created.
rules_guide.start_text_2: The system first tries to find another player with compatible settings. If no suitable player is found for a while, a bot may become your opponent in regular matchmaking.
rules_guide.start_text_3: To play with a specific person, open {friends}, find them by nickname or MGW-ID, open the {more} menu, and choose {invite}.
rules_guide.cost_text: Each player pays {entry} to enter. The total pot for a regular match is therefore currently {pot}.
rules_guide.cost_example: For example, under the current terms, the winner gets their entry fee back together with the winnings: {winner_reward} is credited to the balance. The winner’s net result compared with the balance before the match is {winner_net}.
rules_guide.win_text: {label} the winner receives {winner_reward} from the total pot, while {commission} is the system fee.
rules_guide.loss_text: {label} the entry fee for this match is not refunded.
rules_guide.draw_text: {label} each player gets their entry fee back — currently {draw_refund}. There is no fee on a draw.
rules_guide.leave_title: 4. Do not leave an unfinished match
rules_guide.leave_text: If a match has already started and you leave it manually before it ends, the app will warn you about the consequences. Leaving may count as a technical loss, so it is better to finish the game or return after a temporary connection drop.
rules_guide.game_rules_text: Each game has its own rules, board sizes, and available variants. Before a match or from the game interface, open {rules} to see the rules for the selected game. This section explains the general rules for regular matches and coins.
rules_guide.history_text: The {more} menu includes {balance_history} and {match_history}. There you can review entry deductions, draw refunds, win rewards, and your latest played matches.
rules_guide.bonus_text: The current weekly free-bonus terms are shown separately on the balance card. Use {weekly_bonus} to view the current conditions.
rules_guide.tournaments_text: Tournaments are a separate mode with their own registration, match, and reward rules. The regular-match rules in this window do not replace the rules of a specific tournament.
rules_guide.problems_text: If your balance, match result, or another action looks wrong, open {more_feedback}. To report another player, use the separate {report} item.
